gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme treated with temozolomide (200mg/m2) as monotherapy and patients with recurrent or progressive malignant glioma treated with temozolomide as monotherapy (200mg/m2).

candidate_evidence.quote: Bioequivalence Study Between Temozolomide Oral Suspension (Ped-TMZ) and Temodal® Capsules

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme treated with temozolomide (200mg/m2) as monotherapy and patients with recurrent or progressive malignant glioma treated with temozolomide as monotherapy (200mg/m2).

coder_notes: Bioequivalence study of a new oral suspension of temozolomide versus Temodal capsules; temozolomide is an established GBM therapy so the trial has no candidate. The comparator arm is listed with intervention Ped-TMZ in the registry, but the arm name and description identify the Temodal capsule. Wording 'glioblastoma multiforme' with no IDH or WHO reference coded historical.
